name: Havik
description: Havik is a goblin who borders between the size of a child and a young teenager[cite: 1]. His most dominant feature is a weathered, well-loved cloak of mismatched, patched colors, and he has a habit of nervously picking at its pockets[cite: 1]. His large, unassuming eyes are flecked with gold and hidden behind gold-rimmed spectacles, giving him a nervous energy that belies a sharp, confident gaze[cite: 1]. Operating as 'white hat' security for the Golden Horn Gambling Hall alongside his partner Cade, Havik is opportunistic, clever, and guided by an infallible set of goblin rules[cite: 1].
ideals: Opportunity: 'You take any deal that involves a thousand gold for every noble (Rule #37)[cite: 1].'
Adaptability: 'Don't quit your job, just become a part-time employee (Rule #38)[cite: 1].'
bonds: His partner and fellow security worker, Cade[cite: 1].
The local urchin network (Squidly, Jenks, and Nat), whom he coordinates with[cite: 1].
The Trollskull Manor crew and their shared escapades[cite: 1].
flaws: Prone to opportunistic greed and occasionally soaking his shoes in unexplained substances like gravy[cite: 1].
Anxious energy that occasionally flares up when dealing with strict management or dangerous underground factions[cite: 1].
speech_patterns: Smooth, opportunistic, and informal, frequently citing personal 'goblin rules' to justify wild plans or sudden career changes[cite: 1].
mannerisms: Nervously picks at the pockets of his patched cloak, adjusts his gold-rimmed spectacles, and flashes slow, confident grins when a scheme pays off[cite: 1].

relationships.name: Benethan
relationships.relationship: Food and Beverage Director / Employer at Golden Horn

personality_traits: Loyal to his partner and crew
motivations: To accumulate enough wealth and gold to leave standard security work behind for bigger ventures[cite: 1].
To protect his partner Cade and maintain their legitimate standing in Waterdeep[cite: 1].
knowledge: Underworld connections, street-level urchin communication networks, and goblin rule jurisprudence[cite: 1].
Sorcerous magic, chaos bolts, and practical sleight of hand[cite: 1].
gm_notes: Havik serves as a vibrant, unconventional party member who blends street cunning with sorcerous utility, offering great roleplay opportunities through his network of urchin informants and strict adherence to 'goblin rules'[cite: 1].
